reports.title: Zeta Global Reports 21st Consecutive “Beat and Raise” Quarter, Generates Positive GAAP Net Income in 3Q’26 & YTD, and Achieves the Rule of 71

lines: Increasing full year 2026 revenue guidance by $37 million to $1,855 million at the midpoint, up from prior guidance of $1,818 million, reflecting Y/Y growth of 42%.
Increasing full year 2026 GAAP EPS guidance to $0.23 at the midpoint, up $0.20 or over 600% from our initial guidance of $0.03.
Increasing full year 2026 GAAP EPS guidance to a range of $0.22 to $0.24, up $0.13 at the midpoint from prior guidance of $0.09 to $0.11.
